name: ReInitChart
summary: This EA adds a customizable button to the bottom-right corner of each chart that, when pressed, reinitializes all charts of the current symbol by temporarily changing the chart timeframe. It is a chart management utility, not a trading system.
summary_zh: 该EA在每个图表右下角添加一个可自定义的按钮，按下后通过临时切换图表周期来重新初始化当前品种的所有图表。这是一个图表管理工具，不是交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个图表重初始化工具。其核心概念是通过临时更改图表时间周期来触发图表重绘，从而解决MT5中图表偶尔出现的数据刷新问题。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，没有持仓管理逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在，因为该工具纯粹是界面辅助性质的。用户通过点击按钮手动触发重初始化，EA依赖定时器事件（OnTimer）来执行实际的图表周期切换逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart reinitialization utility. Its core concept is to force chart redraws by temporarily switching the chart timeframe, addressing occasional data refresh issues in MT5. Entry conditions are not applicable since the tool performs no trading operations. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable, with no position management logic. Position sizing and money management are absent since the tool is purely a UIauxiliary tool. The user triggers reinitialization manually via button press, and the EA relies on timer events (OnTimer) to execute the actual timeframe switching logic.
pros: 提供一键刷新图表功能，解决MT5图表数据偶尔不刷新的问题
界面简洁，按钮位置固定在右下角不影响交易操作
按钮文字和颜色可自定义，用户可根据个人偏好调整外观
通过类封装（cChartReInit）实现，代码结构清晰模块化
pros_en: Provides one-click chart refresh to resolve MT5 occasional data display issues
Clean UI with button fixed in bottom-right corner without interfering with trading
Customizable button text and colors for user preference
Well-structured code using class encapsulation (cChartReInit) for modularity
cons: 仅通过临时切换时间周期来重初始化图表，方法较为粗糙且可能导致短暂视觉闪烁
缺乏错误处理机制，未检测图表切换操作是否成功执行
功能单一，仅支持按品种重初始化，无法单独刷新指定图表
未提供按钮位置和大小的自定义选项
cons_en: Reinitializes charts by temporarily switching timeframes, a crude method that may cause brief visual flickering
Lacks error handling, no verification that the timeframe switch operation succeeded
Single-function tool, only supports reinitializing by symbol, cannot refresh individual charts
No customization options for button position and size
improvements: 增加按钮位置和大小的可配置参数，提升界面灵活性
添加错误处理和状态反馈机制，告知用户重初始化是否成功
improvements_en: Add configurable parameters for button position and size to improve UI flexibility
Implement error handling and status feedback to inform users whether reinitialization succeeded

risk_points: 临时切换时间周期可能在低流动性时段触发不必要的图表重载
缺乏操作确认机制，误触按钮可能导致图表短暂异常
risk_points_en: Temporary timeframe switching may trigger unnecessary chart reloads during low liquidity periods
No confirmation mechanism, accidental button press may cause brief chart anomaly

summary_en: This EA adds a customizable button to the bottom-right corner of each chart that, when pressed, reinitializes all charts of the current symbol by temporarily changing the chart timeframe. It is a chart management utility, not a trading system.
